gizmo.title: Isikhumbuzo sokuzibonela
gizmo.description: Cela umfundi acabange ngezinga noma isimo sakhe sengqondo, bese unikeza isikhumbuzo sokuzilungisa esisekelwe empendulweni.

configure.title: Uhlobo lokufaka
configure.description: Indlela umfundi abika ngayo ukuthi wenza kanjani. Kokubili kusebenzisa isikali esingu-0 kuya ku-4 (izinga: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; isimo sengqondo: phansi kakhulu=0 kuya kuhle kakhulu=4).

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Umbuzo womfundi. Yiyeke ingenalutho ukuze kusetshenziswe okuzenzakalelayo kohlobo lokufaka.

configure.title: Izikhumbuzo
configure.description: Impendulo eboniswa ebangeni lezimpendulo. Kusetshenziswa ibanga lokuqala elifanayo.
